title: Refactor: recording efficiency & the plans section
description: Two halves of one problem: agents spend an order of magnitude more output on recording work than on doing it, and the plan — the one file that says what is left and in what order — is buried in agent-memory/ where it has no structure and no home. The audit (measured, 2026-08-02) quantified the first half; the fix spans the agent-ks skills, the global CLAUDE.md, the framework's issue sections, and the CLI. Ships as 0.7.0.
author: sidhantha
